title: Bridge cockpit
description: Declares the Bridge cockpit: the single page (#/_prime_silo/bridge) that unifies the whole cognitive mesh — memory (sessions), documents (knowledge triples), code (AST), flows (plan->run), runs (observability) — with Benny (the onscreen agent) grounded in the current stage. This manifest is the source of truth the page, the benny-pilot skill, the CLI, and the conformance audit are held against. The Bridge consumes the Benny runtime (/api/runtime/*) and Memo-Ray (/api/memoray/*) through the existing proxies; it adds no new server proxy. Runtime payload contracts are documented here but probed by the runtime's own surfaces, not this audit (whose live fetcher targets Memo-Ray) — so the conformance checks are signature, config_surface, and owners.

maintenance.loop: read this manifest -> GET /api/integration_audit (or `node space memory audit`) -> for each drift finding draft a fix at the finding's owner path -> human review -> re-sign via scripts/audit-integrations.mjs --sign

data_model.concept: The Bridge is a mode switcher over one stage. Each mode composes an existing widget against an existing endpoint; nothing is rendered bespoke.

modes.label: Pulse
modes.purpose: Landing: mesh vitals, conformance, and the unified activity feed.

benny.dock: onscreen agent (_core/onscreen_agent, Lemonade-capable) in the right rail
benny.context: bridge-context.js publishes {mode, selection, workspace, lastRun, conformance, route} on window.__bennyBridgeContext and composes grounded prompts for the mode-aware chips
benny.skill: benny-pilot (catalog-loaded) reads the context and answers grounded in the stage, citing Bridge deep links

mesh_position.role: operator cockpit over all three graphs (memory, knowledge, code) plus the act/observe surfaces

endpoints.purpose: Flows: requirement -> SwarmManifest. Body {requirement, workspace, strategy?}.
Flows: execute a planned manifest. Body {workspace}. Returns {run_id, status}.
Code 3D: Tree-Sitter file/class/function graph for a workspace.
Documents: knowledge-graph (semantic triples) for a workspace.
Shared: list workspaces for the workspace selector.
Documents: list workspace files (data_in / data_out / staging).
Documents golden path: ingest workspace documents into semantic triples. Body {workspace}.
Documents: build CORRELATES_WITH edges linking documents and the code graph.
Runs: lineage timeline + reasoning trace events for a run_id.
Pulse: unified activity feed (sessions, artifacts, commits). Declared + probed in memoray.integration.json.
Header conformance strip — both memoray and bridge reports.

process_map.produces: #/_prime_silo/bridge cockpit page (mode rail + stage + Benny dock + zen toggle)
bridgePage Alpine factory — mode switching, widget mount/destroy, golden-path wiring
bridge-context.js — publishes window.__bennyBridgeContext, composes grounded chip prompts, dispatches to the onscreen agent
Pulse landing — overview cards + lifelog feed + conformance
Documents mode — workspace/files + ingest->triples + correlate, rendered as the knowledge graph
Code 3D mode — Tree-Sitter code graph (2D SVG default, three_renderer 3D toggle)
Flows mode — Plan (DAG) then Run; the no-copy-paste golden path
Runs mode — lineage timeline + reasoning trace observability
Bridge tile in the dashboard launcher

BRIDGE_DEFAULT_MODE.doc: Mode the Bridge opens on when no ?mode= is supplied. node space get/set BRIDGE_DEFAULT_MODE.

bridge.default_mode.doc: Wizard manifest record in prime-silo.config.json; surfaced via /api/config_defaults and applied when no query mode is present.

runtime_proxy.doc: All /api/runtime/* hops resolve via RUNTIME_BASE_URL + BENNY_API_KEY in server/lib/runtime_proxy.js; memoray hops via MEMORAY_* (see memoray.integration.json).

conformance.notes: health + payload_contracts are intentionally omitted: this audit's live fetcher targets Memo-Ray, while the Bridge's probed contracts live on the Benny runtime. The runtime endpoints are documented above for the maintaining agent; their live conformance is covered by the runtime's own tests.
